partners.mechanism_chain: CEP290 (HGNC:23894) —DISRUPTS→ Cilium assembly (GO:0007544); Cilium assembly (GO:0007544) —LEADS_TO→ Kidney disease (HP:0000077); PPP2R1A (HGNC:9740) —DISRUPTS→ Basement membrane organization (GO:0007037); Basement membrane organization (GO:0007037) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal abnormalities (HP:0000001); Basement membrane organization (GO:0007037) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). CEP290 is crucial for cilium assembly, and its disruption leads to kidney disease. PPP2R1A is involved in basement membrane organization, and its disruption results in skeletal abnormalities and intellectual disability.
